left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Patient requiring a first total knee prosthesis (scheduled between Tuesday and Friday)
-  Patient that has given his/her free and informed consent and signed the consent form

right.raw_text:
-  The patient must be a member or beneficiary of a health insurance plan
  -  The patient is at least 18 years  [AND] old (≥) and under 90 years old (<)

left.raw_text:
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  The subject is in a period of exclusion determined by a previous study (therapeutic study)
  -  The subject refuses to sign the consent
  -  It is impossible to give the subject informed information
  -  The patient is under safeguard of justice  [OR] or state guardianship
  -  The patient is pregnant  [OR] or breastfeeding
  -  The patient is allergic to latex bandages

-  The subject has contralateral amputation, [OR]  pressure ulcers, severe Obstructive Arteriopathy  [OR] of Lower Limbs, [OR]  lymphoedema or thromboembolic event of the lower limb (ipsilateral  [OR] and / or contralateral  [OR] / superficial  [OR] or deep  [OR] or detected by postoperative Doppler)

right.raw_text: -  The subject has chronic  [OR] or active wounds  [OR] or any cause that hinders normal rehabilitation  [OR] or the application of a bandage

left.raw_text: -  patient with a stroke  [OR] / Disabling Neurological Pathology, Chronic Immunological Pathology  [OR] / Systemic Disease
-  The subject has cognitive  [OR] or behavioral disorders (Parkinson's disease, [OR]  cerebellar syndrome, [OR]  opposition, [OR]  agitation, [OR]  dementia)

right.raw_text: -  The subject has a history of knee surgery
